remarks: Situated proudly on a knoll near the center of town, this beautifully crafted Nantucket-style Colonial blends timeless grandeur with effortless livability. A gracious front-to-back foyer welcomes guests and draws the eye upward to the belvedere, a hidden nook where sunlight pours in and creates a dramatic entrance. The library is wrapped in floor-to-ceiling bookshelves, creating an intimate space to read beside the fireplace, enjoy a drink from the wet bar or relax on the adjoining covered patio. The dining room, centered around a grand fireplace, is equally striking and complemented by a butler's pantry with wet bar for seamless entertaining. At the heart of the home, the well-appointed chef's kitchen features an expansive island with seating for five and opens to a great room, where a fireplace and sunlit dining area create a natural gathering place while opening up to the backyard patio for easy entertaining. Bathed in afternoon light, the formal living room is an elegant setting for fireside conversation and quiet relaxation. Upstairs, a thoughtfully designed office with built-in desks leads to 4 ensuite bedrooms, a huge rec room, laundry facilities and a gracious primary suite, complete with a sitting area, fireplace, dressing room and 2 primary baths for refined tranquility. An oversized three car garage has masterfully designed storage while an expansive unfinished basement offers abundant space and possibilities...all just steps from town, dining, and shopping.
